parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for other components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, shelves, and other parts, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a flat MDF panel used to cover and access the storage space inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet’s interior when opened and conceals stored items when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide or swing open depending on the cabinet design.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is another MDF panel that covers the opposite side of the cabinet’s storage area.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the right section of the cabinet and helps protect contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It can slide or swing open depending on the cabinet design.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and separates items within the cabinet, increasing storage efficiency.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height in some designs.

parts.name: Strip (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The strip is a narrow aluminum component, likely used as a handle or sliding track for the cabinet doors.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a smooth track for door movement or a grip surface for opening and closing the doors.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but interacts with moving parts like the doors.
